subject.title: fix(minimax): resolve search env secret refs

question: Should this credential-routing change wait for a trusted, redacted MiniMax runtime transcript, or should maintainers explicitly accept the focused resolver tests as the proof exception?
rationale: The patch changes fail-closed provider credential selection, but the contributor cannot obtain repository-backed MiniMax credentials from a fork and the submitted evidence is limited to tests and static checks.

options.title: Obtain trusted runtime proof
options.body: Run the exact head with a redacted configured environment SecretRef and a missing reference to demonstrate successful use and fail-closed fallback behavior.

options.title: Explicitly override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the focused resolver tests as sufficient for this credential-only repair and record an explicit proof override.

recommendation.title: Obtain trusted runtime proof
recommendation.body: Run the exact head with a redacted configured environment SecretRef and a missing reference to demonstrate successful use and fail-closed fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has already documented the exact evidence needed and can coordinate a maintainer-run proof, although the final proof exception belongs to repository maintainers.
